title: A day on the Moc Chau plateau
pace: Morning on the hills, falls before dark
summary: One day from the farm town: contour tea in the morning, Dai Yem while the light is up, and the walking street after dark. Na Ka replaces the falls only in blossom or harvest weeks. Visit lengths were not published.

stops.name: Tea rows
stops.note: The hour on this row is not a published visit length. Walk the contour tea in the morning. How long you stay, and the 2026 gate, are check on arrival. Do not sit on the bushes.

stops.name: Dai Yem
stops.note: The hour on this row is not a published visit length. Vietnam Tourism says the drop is over 100 m. The monograph says the first fall drops about 70 m. The two figures do not match. The fee is check on arrival.

stops.name: Walking street
stops.note: After the hills, the night market around the Pha Luong light park. A 2023 feature says weekends are the fuller nights. Clock hours are check on arrival.

seoTitle: A day on the Moc Chau plateau
seoDescription: Tea rows in the morning and Dai Yem before dark, from a farm-town base. Visit lengths, gates, and the Hanoi bus time are check on arrival.
